queries.query: "LLM" OR "large language model" AND ("network configuration" OR "NetOps" OR "network operations") AND (failure OR error OR hallucination OR correctness)
queries.rationale: Identify empirical and conceptual reports of incorrect or unsafe LLM-generated network artifacts (phenomenon: hallucination/misconfiguration).

queries.query: "intent-to-configuration" OR "intent-based networking" AND (LLM OR "language model" OR "natural language")
queries.rationale: Survey approaches that translate high-level operator intent (NL) into device configuration; assess failure modes and specification mismatches.

queries.query: "generate-validate-repair" OR "generate-then-verify" OR "repair loop" AND (LLM OR agent) AND (network OR configuration OR routing)
queries.rationale: Locate architectures combining generation, automated validation, and iterative repair for NetOps tasks (mitigations/mechanisms).

queries.query: "formal verification" AND (network OR configuration OR routing) AND (Batfish OR NetKAT OR Veriflow OR "network verification")
queries.rationale: Collect deterministic/verifiable validators and their specifications to assess integration with LLM outputs and benchmark validity.

queries.query: "LLM" OR "agentic" AND "network change" OR "network management" AND (safety OR rollback OR "change validation")
queries.rationale: Find work on safe execution of network changes, transactional/rollback mechanisms, and how LLM agents interact with change control (mitigation/operational safeguards).
source_preferences: industry automation platforms (Ansible, Nornir) with papers

queries.query: "AIOps" OR "AI for ops" AND (network OR NetOps) AND (benchmark OR dataset OR evaluation)
queries.rationale: Collect existing AIOps/NetOps benchmarks and datasets to evaluate benchmark validity and gaps for LLM-based agents.

queries.query: "Mininet" OR "NS-3" OR "network emulator" AND ("evaluation" OR "testing" OR "LLM")
queries.rationale: Identify simulation/emulation environments used to test generated configs and agentic workflows (methods & reproducible testbeds).

queries.query: "prompt sensitivity" OR "prompt robustness" AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (network OR configuration OR "domain shift")
queries.rationale: Investigate mechanisms whereby prompt formulation and distributional shift create errors in domain-specific generation (mechanisms to failure).
source_preferences: industry blog posts only if accompanied by reproducible artifacts

queries.query: "tool use" OR "tool-augmented" OR "external verifier" AND (LLM OR agent) AND (network OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Survey methods that augment LLMs with external tools (e.g., validators, CLI emulators, configuration synthesizers) as mitigations for unsafe outputs.

queries.query: "evaluation metrics" AND (NetOps OR network configuration OR AIOps) AND (correctness OR safety OR rollback OR "false positive" OR "false negative" OR "time-to-repair")
queries.rationale: Gather candidate operational metrics for measuring reliability and safety of LLM-generated NetOps actions (benchmark validity & methods).

queries.query: "program synthesis" OR "program repair" AND (network OR configuration OR "policy synthesis" OR "NetKAT")
queries.rationale: Find adjacent research using synthesis/repair techniques for network configs that can inform methods and mitigations for LLM outputs.

queries.query: "human-in-the-loop" OR "operator-in-the-loop" AND (NetOps OR network OR configuration) AND (LLM OR agent)
queries.rationale: Examine mixed-initiative workflows and empirical evidence for when human oversight reduces error and how to integrate it (mitigations/validity).

queries.query: "benchmarks" AND (LLM OR foundation model) AND (limitations OR "threats to validity" OR "benchmark validity")
queries.rationale: Capture methodological critiques of LLM benchmarks to guide evaluation design and avoid overclaiming (benchmark validity/neighbouring critique literature).

queries.query: "security" OR "adversarial" AND (LLM OR agent) AND (network OR NetOps OR configuration)
queries.rationale: Explore adversarial failure modes where malicious inputs or model manipulation produce unsafe network changes (phenomenon & mitigations).

inclusion_criteria: Primary sources: peer-reviewed conference/journal articles, arXiv preprints with verifiable artifacts or code, official tool/documentation pages (Batfish, Veriflow, Mininet).
Works presenting empirical experiments, reproducible datasets, or open-source code enabling verification of claims.
Surveys, systematic reviews, and standards/RFCs relevant to network automation, intent-based networking, or verification.
Benchmarks, datasets, and evaluation suites with publicly available descriptions and artifacts.
Industry technical reports only if they provide primary data, reproducible artifacts, or link to open repositories.
exclusion_criteria: Pure marketing, press releases, social-media posts, or opinion pieces without technical substance or reproducible artifacts.
Proprietary internal reports or paywalled documents that cannot be accessed for verification.
Works unrelated to network operations (e.g., general-language-only LLM papers without operational grounding) unless they specifically address mechanisms transferable to NetOps.
Duplicate secondary citations where the primary source is available (prefer primary).
Non-English works unless an English translation or summary is available.
date_rationale: Primary focus on recent developments (2017–2026) to capture the Transformer/LLM era and rapid advances in agentic systems, tool use, and AIOps; include earlier seminal literature (pre-2017) for foundational topics such as formal network verification, intent-based networking, and program synthesis. This window balances novelty (latest LLM-agent and AIOps work) with necessary historical context for verification and operational controls.
